title: Indian e-Visa from the UK | Apply Online in 4 Easy Steps
description: Apply for your Indian e-Visa from the UK in four easy steps. Our Manchester team checks your photo, passport and every detail before it’s submitted.
heroIntro: Apply for your Indian e-Visa the easy way. You do the simple part; we handle the official form, check every detail and submit it for you.

steps.title: Apply online
steps.text: Answer a few simple questions and upload your photo and passport page.

steps.title: We check and submit
steps.text: An adviser reviews every answer, fixes photo or document problems and submits it.

steps.title: Receive your ETA
steps.text: Your Electronic Travel Authorisation is emailed to you once approved.

steps.title: Fly to India
steps.text: Print your ETA and show it at immigration, where your e-Visa is stamped in your passport.

checksTitle: What we check before it’s submitted
checksIntro: Most e-Visa problems come from small mistakes the official form won’t warn you about. Once submitted, the government fee can’t be refunded, so we catch them first.

checks.title: Your photo
checks.text: Square, a plain light background, full face and the right file size. We crop and resize it for you.

checks.title: Your passport scan
checks.text: A clear photo page in the format and size the form accepts, with at least 6 months left and 2 blank pages.

checks.title: Whether you can use an e-Visa
checks.text: Some people can’t, including those of Pakistani origin or with a military or police background. We tell you before you pay.

checks.title: Every detail
checks.text: Names, dates and passport number must match exactly. A mistake on an approved e-Visa can mean applying again.

sections.heading: Indian e-Visa for UK residents
sections.text:
British citizens and people from more than 170 other countries can visit India on an e-Visa. It’s applied for online, approved by email and stamped into your passport when you land. There are e-Visas for tourism, business, conferences, medical treatment, study, transit and more.

We’re a private company based in Manchester. You can apply yourself on the official Government of India website and pay only the government fee. Our clients use us because they want a person to check their eligibility, fix their photo and documents and submit everything correctly the first time.

sections.heading: How long does an Indian e-Visa take?
sections.text:
Most complete applications are decided within a few working days. Apply at least 4 days before you arrive in India, and no more than 120 days before. We suggest 2 to 3 weeks ahead, so there’s time to fix anything.

Your Indian e-Visa arrives by email. Print it and carry it with your passport; immigration stamps the visa into your passport when you land.

faqs.a: Yes. You can apply on the official site, indianvisaonline.gov.in, and pay only the government fee. People use us when they want a person to check everything, fix their photo and documents, and handle the form for them.
At least 4 days before you arrive in India, and no more than 120 days before. We recommend applying 2 to 3 weeks ahead in case anything needs correcting.

faqs.q: I have a British passport but my family is from Pakistan. Can I get an e-Visa?
faqs.a: Usually not. Indian rules don’t allow an e-Visa if your parents or grandparents were born in, or lived permanently in, Pakistan, even on a British passport. You’ll need a regular visa, and we can help with that.

faqs.q: What happens when I arrive in India?
faqs.a: Show your printed e-Visa at immigration. Your fingerprints and photo are taken, and the visa is stamped in your passport. You must enter through one of the airports or seaports approved for e-Visas.

faqs.q: How long is an Indian e-Visa valid?
faqs.a: It depends on the type: 30 days, 1 year or 5 years for tourism, and 1 year for business. Each visa page explains the rules.
